# @zakkster/lite-ui-fx
> Canvas-hijacked UI components with pluggable recipe system. 56 built-in recipes.

VERSION 1.6.0

## Install
npm i @zakkster/lite-ui-fx

## Core Concept
Native HTML element (opacity:0, z-index:2) handles events + a11y.
Canvas overlay (z-index:1) renders visuals via a recipe factory function.
Recipe = { tick(), init?(), onHover?(), onClick?(), onToggle?(), onDrag?(), destroy?() }

## Import -- Controller
import { mountUIFX, decorateUIFX, UIType } from '@zakkster/lite-ui-fx';

## Import -- Recipes (one ./recipes subpath, 56 total, tree-shakeable)
import { SwarmToggle, MagneticButton, SparkSlider } from '@zakkster/lite-ui-fx/recipes';
import { PendulumToggle, HeartbeatButton, AuroraSlider } from '@zakkster/lite-ui-fx/recipes';
import { VolumeKnob, WaterLevel, TimerCountdown } from '@zakkster/lite-ui-fx/recipes';

## Import -- Recipe registry (data-driven pickers)
import { RECIPES, RECIPE_META, RECIPE_NAMES, registerRecipe, mountRecipe } from '@zakkster/lite-ui-fx/recipes';
// RECIPES id->factory (null-proto); RECIPE_META { id, name, type, family, themeable, motionSafe }; RECIPE_NAMES frozen.
// mountRecipe(container, id, options?): resolves id fail-closed (did-you-mean), asserts META.type, mounts.

## Mount -- two modes
// HIJACK (mountUIFX): creates a native element (opacity:0) inside `container` and
// paints a canvas over it. The native element owns events + a11y.
const instance = mountUIFX(container, UIType.TOGGLE, SwarmToggle, { label: 'Sound' });
instance.setValue(v);   // SLIDER/KNOB/PROGRESS: v in 0..1 (fires onDrag once); CHECKBOX: setValue(null) = indeterminate
instance.setChecked(b); // TOGGLE/CHECKBOX: set checked (fires onToggle once)
instance.destroy();     // cleanup
// DECORATE (decorateUIFX): a canvas AROUND an EXISTING visible element -- no
// native element created, no opacity:0, host never reparented; the overlay is a
// sibling placed from the host's offset box, removed on destroy (host byte-
// identical). State is wired from the host's own events; for a form-control host
// state.text/state.valid mirror el.value/el.validity (read at event time). This
// is the home for a decoration over a real input.
const deco = decorateUIFX(inputEl, PasswordStrength, { theme });
deco.destroy();         // removes ONLY the overlay + its listeners; host untouched
// setValue/setChecked are HIJACK-ONLY: they throw in decorate mode (a decoration
// reflects the host; it does not drive it).

## Options (4th arg; unknown option or recipe-hook keys throw a did-you-mean -- fail closed)
width, height, padding=40, label   // geometry + accessible label
value     // slider start, number 0..1 (default 0.5); out-of-range or non-number throws
checked   // toggle start, boolean (default false)
disabled  // native disabled attr + state.disabled for recipes to render
seed      // recipe RNG seed (finite number)
colors    // string[] palette override; wins over theme (array-palette recipes: IS the palette)
theme     // { light, mid, dark } -> accent/dim/surface; partial or wrong-shape throws
text      // visible canvas label; falls back to label, then the recipe default (label-in-name)
font      // canvas font string; falls back to the recipe's historical font
knobMode  // KNOB only: 'rotate' | 'vertical' pointer mapping (default 'rotate'); wrong type throws
announce  // PROGRESS only: opt-in aria-live announcements at 10% steps; wrong type throws
// decorateUIFX accepts a SUBSET: padding, seed, colors, theme, text, font. The
// hijack-only keys (width/height/value/checked/disabled/knobMode/announce/label)
// throw in decorate mode -- geometry comes from the host, value is read from it.

## Element Types
UIType.TOGGLE   -> <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> -> state.toggled, onToggle(checked)
UIType.BUTTON   -> <button> -> state.active, onClick(x, y, state)
UIType.SLIDER   -> <input type="range"> -> state.val (0-1), onDrag(val, velocity)
UIType.CHECKBOX -> <input type="checkbox"> (no role=switch) -> state.toggled + state.indeterminate, onToggle(checked)
UIType.PROGRESS -> <progress> (non-interactive) -> state.val, driven by instance.setValue
UIType.KNOB     -> <input type="range"> -> state.val, arrows native + knobMode pointer map, onDrag(val, velocity)
(decorate)      -> NO native element created; a canvas AROUND a live host (decorateUIFX). Not a UIType --
                   RECIPE_META.type 'decorate' routes mountRecipe to decorateUIFX. State: focused + text + valid.

## State Object (provided to tick every frame)
{ hover, active, focused, toggled, indeterminate, disabled, val, w, h, padding, dpr }
// decorate mode adds: text (host value string), valid (host validity boolean).

## 56 Built-in Recipes

### Vol. 1 -- 10 recipes
Toggles: SwarmToggle, LiquidToggle, NeonPulseToggle
Buttons: MagneticButton, ShatterButton, ConfettiButton, GlitchButton
Sliders: SparkSlider, CosmicSlider, LaserSlider

### Vol. 2 -- 20 recipes
Toggles: PendulumToggle, CircuitToggle, LightningToggle, DNAToggle
Buttons: HeartbeatButton, BreathingButton, InkSplashButton, PixelDissolveButton, FireworkButton
Sliders: AuroraSlider, WaveSlider, ElasticBandSlider, GravitySlider
Loaders: OrbitLoader, HelixLoader
Checkboxes: RippleCheck, MorphCheck
Counters: FlameCounter, GlitchCounter
Rating: BubbleRating

### Vol. 3 -- 20 recipes
Knobs: VolumeKnob, CompassKnob
Progress: RingProgress, BatteryGauge, SignalMeter
Controls: PillTabs, Stepper, RadioOrbit
Indicators: PasswordStrength, WaterLevel, HeatMap
Mood: DayNightToggle, ReactionPicker, NotificationBell
Feedback: TypewriterField, SoundWaveBtn, UploadProgress
Fun: ScratchReveal, TimerCountdown, PullRefresh

### U4a -- 3 recipes (new element types)
Checkboxes (UIType.CHECKBOX): TickDraw, IndeterminateScan
Progress (UIType.PROGRESS): LiquidFill

### U4b -- 3 recipes (decorate mode: a canvas AROUND a live element)
Form feedback (decorateUIFX): FocusHalo, ErrorShake, SuccessBloom
// Re-homed to decorate mode (type 'decorate'): PasswordStrength (reads the live
// input's text), TypewriterField (an underline that grows with the typed text).

## Writing Custom Recipes
See UIFX-RECIPE-GUIDE.md (included in package).

## Dependencies
@zakkster/lite-ticker, @zakkster/lite-lerp, @zakkster/lite-random

## Key Facts
- DPR-aware canvas (retina sharp)
- AbortController cleanup on destroy
- Ref-counted shared Ticker (one RAF for all components)
- Safari-safe roundRect polyfill in recipes
- Accessibility: role=switch, aria-label, keyboard focus tracking
- Zero-GC in all built-in recipes: const colors + globalAlpha, precomputed
  color/label LUTs, fixed preallocated particle pools, gradients built in init.
  Gated per recipe by the t3-frame-alloc torture tier (default AND themed mount).
- Themeable: all 56 recipes honour { colors, theme:{light,mid,dark}, text, font },
  resolved once in init (zero per-frame alloc). RECIPE_META.themeable is true for
  all 56; motionSafe stays false (reduced motion is a later pass). A bare mount is
  byte-identical to pre-theming. Shipped palettes + APCA contrast are authored with
  @zakkster/lite-hueforge (a dev-only tool, never a runtime dependency).
- U4a element types: CHECKBOX (indeterminate), PROGRESS (setValue-driven, aria-live
  opt-in), KNOB (knobMode pointer map); setValue/setChecked sync native+state+hook once.
- U4b decorate mode (decorateUIFX): a canvas AROUND a live element -- no hijack, no
  opacity:0, host never reparented; the overlay is a sibling placed from the host's
  offset box and removed on destroy (host byte-identical, additive-only). State is
  wired from the host's own events (state.text/state.valid at event time). It is the
  second mount mode + the surface the enrichment decorations build on.
